title: Align Telegram package with upstream main

acceptanceCriteria.text: Local Telegram package incorporates approved upstream main changes while preserving portable VCS packaging and standard asyncio startup.
Session concurrency, transport, dependency, and tool-surface changes are reconciled with explicit security and compatibility decisions.
Deterministic tests and targeted live MCP startup verification pass without exposing credentials.

workItems.title: Classify upstream changes and freeze migration contract
Port upstream changes in reviewed batches
Validate, review, and verify the aligned package
